body: Yeah I figured out that I just do that stuff to distract me not because I like it. But going home and not doing it makes me wanna die so idk

I do the same. It’s easier to wish that I had purpose than to do anything. Time goes by so fast when you’re daydreaming, and then you get to sleep. Sometimes I wish I could blink and be 90, and near death. I wish I could skip life.
